    capacity = instance["capacity"]
    dist = instance["distance_matrix"]

    def route_load(route):

        for x in route:
            s += demands[x]
        return s

    def route_cost(route):
        if not route:
            return 0
        c = dist[depot][route[0]]
        for i in range(len(route) - 1):
            c += dist[route[i]][route[i + 1]]
        c += dist[route[-1]][depot]
        return c

    def two_opt(route):
        n = len(route)
        if n < 4:
            return route

        while improved:

            best_i = -1
            best_j = -1

                b = route[i]

    seed_order = sorted(remaining, key=lambda x: (dist[depot][x], demands[x], x), reverse=True)

    while remaining_set:
        # Choose a seed: prefer far/high-demand unassigned customers.
        seed = None
        for x in seed_order:
            if x in remaining_set and demands[x] <= capacity:
                seed = x
                break
        if seed is None:
            seed = min(remaining_set)

        route = [seed]
        load = demands[seed]
        remaining_set.remove(seed)

        # Greedy double-ended insertion with a mild preference for tighter packing.
        while True:
            feasible = []
            slack = capacity - load
            for x in remaining_set:
                dx = demands[x]
                if dx <= slack:
                    feasible.append(x)
            if not feasible:
                break

            first = route[0]
            last = route[-1]

            best_x = None
            best_side = 0
            best_key = None

            for x in feasible:
                add_end = dist[last][x] + dist[x][depot] - dist[last][depot]
                add_start = dist[depot][x] + dist[x][first] - dist[depot][first]

                # Prefer lower incremental cost, but break ties by using larger demand and
                # by avoiding leaving tiny leftover capacity that strands heavy customers.
                rem_after = slack - demands[x]
                key_end = (add_end, rem_after, -demands[x], x)
                key_start = (add_start, rem_after, -demands[x], x)

                if key_end <= key_start:
                    key = key_end
                    side = 1
                else:
                    key = key_start
                    side = -1

                if best_key is None or key < best_key:
                    best_key = key
                    best_x = x
                    best_side = side

            if best_x is None:
                break
            if best_side == 1:
                route.append(best_x)
            else:
                route.insert(0, best_x)
            remaining_set.remove(best_x)
            load += demands[best_x]

        routes.append(route)

    # Intra-route improvement.
    for i in range(len(routes)):
        routes[i] = two_opt(routes[i])

    # Inter-route relocate and swap improvements.
    def try_relocate(routes):
        best = None
        m = len(routes)
        loads = [route_load(r) for r in routes]
        costs = [route_cost(r) for r in routes]
        for i in range(m):
            ri = routes[i]
            if not ri:
                continue
            for p in range(len(ri)):
                x = ri[p]
                for j in range(m):
                    if i == j:
                        continue
                    rj = routes[j]
                    if loads[j] + demands[x] > capacity:
                        continue

                    prev_i = depot if p == 0 else ri[p - 1]
                    next_i = depot if p == len(ri) - 1 else ri[p + 1]
                    remove_delta = dist[prev_i][next_i] - dist[prev_i][x] - dist[x][next_i]

                    for q in range(len(rj) + 1):
                        prev_j = depot if q == 0 else rj[q - 1]
                        next_j = depot if q == len(rj) else rj[q]
                        insert_delta = dist[prev_j][x] + dist[x][next_j] - dist[prev_j][next_j]
                        delta = remove_delta + insert_delta
                        if best is None or delta < best[0] or (delta == best[0] and (i, p, j, q, x) < best[1]):
                            best = (delta, (i, p, j, q, x))
        return best

    def try_swap(routes):
        best = None
        m = len(routes)
        loads = [route_load(r) for r in routes]
        for i in range(m):
            ri = routes[i]
            for j in range(i + 1, m):
                rj = routes[j]
                for p in range(len(ri)):
                    a = ri[p]
                    prev_i = depot if p == 0 else ri[p - 1]
                    next_i = depot if p == len(ri) - 1 else ri[p + 1]
                    rem_i = dist[prev_i][next_i] - dist[prev_i][a] - dist[a][next_i]
                    for q in range(len(rj)):
                        b = rj[q]
                        if loads[i] - demands[a] + demands[b] > capacity:
                            continue
                        if loads[j] - demands[b] + demands[a] > capacity:
                            continue
                        prev_j = depot if q == 0 else rj[q - 1]
                        next_j = depot if q == len(rj) - 1 else rj[q + 1]
                        rem_j = dist[prev_j][next_j] - dist[prev_j][b] - dist[b][next_j]

                        ins_i = dist[prev_i][b] + dist[b][next_i] - dist[prev_i][next_i]
                        ins_j = dist[prev_j][a] + dist[a][next_j] - dist[prev_j][next_j]
                        delta = rem_i + rem_j + ins_i + ins_j
                        if best is None or delta < best[0] or (delta == best[0] and (i, p, j, q, a, b) < best[1]):
                            best = (delta, (i, p, j, q, a, b))
        return best

    changed = True
    rounds = 0
    while changed and rounds < 3:
        changed = False
        rounds += 1

        rel = try_relocate(routes)
        if rel is not None and rel[0] < 0:
            _, (i, p, j, q, x) = rel
            node = routes[i].pop(p)
            routes[j].insert(q, node)
            routes[i] = two_opt(routes[i])
            routes[j] = two_opt(routes[j])
            changed = True
            continue

        swp = try_swap(routes)
        if swp is not None and swp[0] < 0:
            _, (i, p, j, q, a, b) = swp
            routes[i][p], routes[j][q] = routes[j][q], routes[i][p]
            routes[i] = two_opt(routes[i])
            routes[j] = two_opt(routes[j])
            changed = True
            continue

    # Final cleanup: remove any empty routes.
    routes = [r for r in routes if r]

    # Deterministic ordering of routes for stability.
    routes.sort(key=lambda r: (route_load(r), route_cost(r), len(r), r[0]))
    return routes
